full_prompt_en: A square color photograph looks almost straight down onto a deep teal urban pond filled with hundreds of small orange fish. The water occupies the central and largest part of the frame, a dark blue-green field broken by cloudy pale turquoise patches and several bright white reflections. Fish form loose swirling bands, most densely along the right half and lower center, where their slender orange bodies create living streaks against the dark surface. Individual fish remain visible in the thinner areas, while the dense groups merge into a glowing copper texture. At the left and right edges, paved pedestrian walkways curve around the pond. Many people appear as tiny dark overhead figures standing or strolling along the paths; the right walkway is especially bright and crowded, its pale surface cutting a clean curved border against the water. On the left, a dark shaded path descends along the upper edge. Broad green tree crowns intrude from the lower left and lower right, partially covering the pond's rim and giving the photograph another layer of scale. The camera's steep height flattens depth into a graphic map, but the small figures and fish show the enormous size of the water. Bright reflections scatter near the middle left, where sunlight penetrates to a lighter turquoise. The fish gather around that light and spread out into the darker lower area. Colors are vivid but limited: turquoise and deep petroleum blue dominate, copper-orange supplies a bright mobile counterpoint, and muted foliage green frames the bottom. Edges of the paths and tree crowns are sharp, while the water carries fine mottled texture and transparency. The composition balances the still geometry of the curving banks against the fluid density of the fish, making the everyday urban view appear almost abstract from above.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形彩色照片几乎垂直俯视一片深青绿色城市池水，水里满是数百条小橙鱼。水占据中央与全幅最大面积，是一块深蓝绿色域，被云状浅青绿斑和几处明亮白反光打断。鱼群组成松散旋转的色带，右半部与下方中央最密，细长橙色鱼身在暗水上形成活着的光痕。稀处能辨单条鱼，密处则融成发亮铜色纹理。左右边缘，铺地人行步道绕着池水弯曲。许多人是从上方看见的极小深色身形，站着或沿路走；右步道格外亮而拥挤，浅色铺地在水边切出清楚弧线。左上还有一条深阴影小路向下延伸。宽大的绿树冠从左右下角伸入，部分遮住池缘，也为照片提供另一层尺度。相机的高俯视把纵深压成图形地图，但小人物与鱼显示出水面的巨大。明亮反光散在中心偏左，日光在那里穿入较浅青绿处。鱼在这片光附近聚集，又向更暗的下部散开。颜色鲜明但有限：青绿与深石油蓝为主，铜橙提供亮而流动的对照，低调叶绿框住底边。步道与树冠边缘清楚，水面则有细斑肌理与透明感。构图平衡弯曲岸线的静止几何与鱼群流动密度，使寻常城市视角从高处看来几乎抽象。
style_prompt_en: High-angle color photography compresses a complex scene into a graphic field of curving boundaries and countless small marks. Deep teal and petroleum blue occupy a broad textured center, punctuated by dense copper-orange clusters and isolated pale reflections. Sharp light peripheral edges frame a more fluid, mottled interior. Repeated tiny accents form flowing bands with variable density, giving motion to an otherwise stable overhead composition. A few muted green masses soften the strict geometry. Natural light creates localized turquoise openings and white glints, while shadow keeps the surrounding color rich. The image balances maplike clarity with lively granular texture and a strong warm-cool contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 高角度彩色摄影把复杂景象压成由弯曲边界与无数小记号组成的图形色域。深青绿和石油蓝占据宽阔有纹理的中心，密集铜橙簇与孤立浅色反光点缀其间。外围清楚的浅边框住更流动斑驳的内部。重复微小重点形成密度多变的流动色带，让原本稳定的俯视构图有动势。几块低调绿形软化严格几何。自然光在局部打开青绿亮处与白闪点，阴影让周围色彩浓厚。影像在地图般清晰、活跃颗粒肌理和强冷暖对比之间平衡。
theme_en: Orange fish swirling in a deep teal urban pond seen from above
theme_zh: 俯视城市池水中成群橙鱼在深青绿色里游动
name: Navid Baraty
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
